description: This file defines enums, structs, and error handling related to gateway connection authentication errors and recovery steps in a networked application, including specific error codes and structured error representations.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayConnectAuthError with message, detail code, retry possibility, and optional recommended next step.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Convenience initializer that accepts detail code and recommended next step as String.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.detailCode
methods.description: Returns the detail code as an optional String.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.recommendedNextStepCode
methods.description: Returns the recommended next step code as an optional String.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.detail
methods.description: Returns the detailed error code as a GatewayConnectAuthDetailCode enum if possible.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.recommendedNextStep
methods.description: Returns the recommended next step as a GatewayConnectRecoveryNextStep enum if possible.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.errorDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the error message.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.isNonRecoverable
methods.description: Determines whether the error is non-recoverable based on the detail code.

methods.name: GatewayResponseError.init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayResponseError with method, code, message, and details.

methods.name: GatewayResponseError.errorDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the response error.

methods.name: GatewayDecodingError.init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayDecodingError with method and message.

methods.name: GatewayDecodingError.errorDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the decoding error.
